method: Official patriarchal, diocesan, parish, monastery, and governmental sources were checked. Search and map results were used only to discover candidates and were not accepted as proof of canonical parentage.

candidates.name: Three privately owned chapels in the Jyväskylä parish area
candidates.reason: The official parish page says privately owned chapels exist in Hankasalmi, Keuruu, and Konnevesi, but it gives no names, patrons, addresses, stable service schedules, or separate pages from which reliable rows can be formed.

candidates.name: Orthodox worship activity in Utajärvi
candidates.status: hold for a stable current venue
candidates.reason: The Northern Finland parish says services are held in Utajärvi but directs readers to check the venue for each service. No stable current worship address is published.

candidates.name: Former recurring Orthodox worship site at Juva parish center
candidates.reason: The Saimaa parish names the Juva parish center at Virastotie 2 but says services there are suspended during the building renovation. It is retained until the parish resumes a current recurring venue.

candidates.name: Church of the Kazan Icon of the Mother of God in Pori
candidates.status: hold for current Moscow Patriarchate confirmation
candidates.reason: An official 2008 Moscow Patriarchate source documents the church's consecration, but the current official external institutions calendar lists the Helsinki and Turku bodies without Pori. Current activity and administrative status could not be established.

candidates.name: Romanian Orthodox communities in Helsinki, Tampere, Turku, and Mariehamn
candidates.status: not published as separate ecclesial bodies
candidates.reason: The Romanian diocesan page names the four communities but explicitly places them in the autonomous Finnish Church. It supplies no distinct parish names, dedications, canonical subordination, or permanent sites beyond the Finnish Church locations already published.

candidates.name: Serbian Orthodox monthly services in Helsinki
candidates.status: not published as a separate ecclesial body
candidates.reason: The current governmental church report says there are no Serbian parishes in Finland and that monthly Helsinki services occur with permission of the Finnish Church. No distinct parish, mission, chapel, or stable worship site is officially identified.

candidates.name: Ukrainian Orthodox community in Helsinki
candidates.status: represented within the published Finnish Church rows
candidates.reason: Official Ukrainian and Finnish Church sources place the community and its regular bilingual services at the Prophet Elijah church of the Helsinki parish. It is not published a second time as an independent jurisdictional body.

superseded_or_not_current.name: Former Orthodox prayer room in Raahe
superseded_or_not_current.reason: The parish closed the Brahenkatu 2 prayer room in June 2026 because of indoor air problems. Current services are held at Pattijoki Rectory, which is published instead.

superseded_or_not_current.name: Former Orthodox chapel in Paltamo
superseded_or_not_current.reason: The official Kainuu sacred places page says the Paltamo chapel has been removed from use, so it is not published as a current worship site.
